result.instructions: Tools for QuotaPath, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which deals did we add this week, and who owns each one?"; "Show the payouts that were resolved since yesterday."; "List the compensation plans and their paths, so I can pick the right path for a new deal.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes QuotaPath data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run quotapath_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run quotapath_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run quotapath_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. quotapath_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: quotapath_list_deals
tools.title: List deals
tools.description: List deals in the QuotaPath workspace. Filter by id, integration_id (your system's id), path_id or user_email (deal owner). Uses GET /v1/deal/.

integration_id.description: Filter by your system's id for the deal.

limit.description: Maximum records to return (vendor default when omitted).

tools.name: quotapath_get_deal
tools.title: Get a deal
tools.description: Get one deal by uuid, with its deal values, metadata and state. Uses GET /v1/deal/{uuid}/.

tools.name: quotapath_create_deal
tools.title: Create a deal
tools.description: Create one deal in QuotaPath, with its owner, amounts per path and state. This changes commission data: confirm the owner, path ids and amounts first. Uses POST /v1/deal/.

user_email.description: Email of the deal owner (a QuotaPath user).

path_id.description: Path uuid this amount applies to (from quotapath_list_plans).

deal_values.description: Amounts per path. Each needs path_id and value.

integration_id.description: Your system's id for this deal. Keeps the deal linked to your CRM record.

admin_locked.description: Lock the deal so only admins can change it.

metadata.description: Optional custom fields used by the plan's paths.

tools.name: quotapath_bulk_create_deals
tools.title: Bulk create deals
tools.description: Create many deals in one call. Each item uses the same fields as quotapath_create_deal. This changes commission data. Uses POST /v1/deal/bulk/.

user_email.description: Email of the deal owner (a QuotaPath user).

path_id.description: Path uuid this amount applies to (from quotapath_list_plans).

deal_values.description: Amounts per path. Each needs path_id and value.

integration_id.description: Your system's id for this deal. Keeps the deal linked to your CRM record.

admin_locked.description: Lock the deal so only admins can change it.

metadata.description: Optional custom fields used by the plan's paths.

tools.name: quotapath_update_deal
tools.title: Update a deal
tools.description: Change some fields of one deal. Send only the fields to change; the others stay as they are. Uses PATCH /v1/deal/{uuid}/.

user_email.description: Email of the deal owner (a QuotaPath user).

path_id.description: Path uuid this amount applies to (from quotapath_list_plans).

deal_values.description: Amounts per path. Each needs path_id and value.

integration_id.description: Your system's id for this deal. Keeps the deal linked to your CRM record.

admin_locked.description: Lock the deal so only admins can change it.

metadata.description: Optional custom fields used by the plan's paths.

tools.name: quotapath_delete_deal
tools.title: Delete a deal
tools.description: Remove one deal from QuotaPath. This cannot be undone through this server. Check the deal with quotapath_get_deal first, and get the user's OK. Uses DELETE /v1/deal/{uuid}/.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the user confirms this deletion.

tools.name: quotapath_list_payouts
tools.title: List payouts
tools.description: List all payouts, resolved and unresolved. Use updated_since to fetch only changes since a Unix time in seconds. Uses GET /v1/payout/.

updated_since.description: Unix timestamp in seconds. Returns records updated after it.

limit.description: Maximum records to return (vendor default when omitted).

tools.name: quotapath_list_resolved_payouts
tools.title: List resolved payouts
tools.description: List resolved payouts, the ones that can go to your external software systems. Use updated_since to fetch only changes. Uses GET /v1/payout/resolved/.

updated_since.description: Unix timestamp in seconds. Returns records updated after it.

limit.description: Maximum records to return (vendor default when omitted).

tools.name: quotapath_list_unresolved_payouts
tools.title: List unresolved payouts
tools.description: List payouts that are not resolved yet. Uses GET /v1/payout/unresolved/.

limit.description: Maximum records to return (vendor default when omitted).

tools.name: quotapath_list_plans
tools.title: List compensation plans
tools.description: List compensation plans with their assignments and paths. Path uuids from here go into deal values. Uses GET /v1/plan/.

limit.description: Maximum records to return (vendor default when omitted).

tools.name: quotapath_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List teams in the QuotaPath workspace with their current members and managers. Uses GET /v1/team/.

limit.description: Maximum records to return (vendor default when omitted).

tools.name: quotapath_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users in the QuotaPath workspace (name and email). Use the email as user_email on a deal. Uses GET /v1/user/.

limit.description: Maximum records to return (vendor default when omitted).
